title: tanacetum tanacetoides
intro: Tanacetum tanacetoides, commonly known as Tansy, is a perennial plant native to Europe and Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Tansy include thujone, borneol, and borneol acetate, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including its ability to act as a nervine, antispasmodic, and antiseptic. Tansy's health benefits are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and provide relief from anxiety and insomnia.
